questions.question: The agricultural price support program is an example of _________.
questions.solution:
A price ceiling

 
 
 
It is a situation when the price charged is more than or less than the equilibrium price by market.

 
 
 

 
 
A price floor

 
 
 
A price floor is the lowest legal price that can be sold commonly. It is used by the government to prevent prices from being too low.

 
 
 

 
 
Equilibrium pricing

 
 
 
It is the market price where the quantity of goods supplies is equal to the number of goods in demand.

 
 
 

 

So, the agricultural price support program is an example of a price floor.

questions.question: What is formed when helium atom loses one electron?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Positive helium ion.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Two protons **and **either one or two neutrons,** depending on the isotope, are kept together by the** strong force** in the helium nucleus.
 
• It is made up of** two electrons** bound by the **electromagnetic force** to it.
 
• A** helium atom gains a positive charge **when electrons are lost because there are** more protons **in the** helium atom than electrons.**
 
• Helium forms a positive ion with** a +1 charge** when it loses one electron.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Proton:**

 
 
• With an** elementary electric charge of +1 e**, a proton is a **stable subatomic particle.**
 
 
 
• **Negative helium ion:**
 
 
• Collisions between **ground-state helium atoms** and the **lead and magnesium vapours** in the energy range of** 20 to 40 keV** resulted in the production of **helium-negative ions.**
 
 
 
• **Alpha particle:**
 
 
• **Two protons and two neutrons **are joined together to form the alpha particle.

questions.question: What is the basis of classifying various plant tissues as meristematic tissue and permanent tissue?
questions.solution:
**Meristem** is the tissue in the most plants containing undifferentiated cells found in zones of the plant where growth can take place.

A group of cells which are similar in origin, similar in structure and similar in function are called **Permanent **tissue.

**Dividing capacity** is the basis of classifying various plant tissues as meristematic tissue and permanent tissue.

questions.question: We obtain average _________ by dividing the total energy consumed by the total time taken.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is** Power.**

**Power:**

 
• Power is defined as the rate of doing work or the rate of transfer of energy.
 
• It can also be said as the amount of work done in a given amount of time.
 
• SI unit of power is represented by Watt (W). Formulae for power is given by p = W /t.

**Average Power** = Total energy consumed/ Total time taken

Pₐvg = ∆W/ ∆t

 
• Power is the rate of doing work and the amount of energy transferred per unit time.
 
• It is a scalar quantity.
 
• The unit is joule per second (J/s).

questions.question: Water covers _______% of the Earth’s surface.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is option 2 i.e __**70 %**__

About **75%** of the Earth’s surface is water-covered and the oceans hold for about 96.5% of all Earth’s water.

Water also exists in the air as water vapour in rivers and lakes, icecaps and glaciers and in the ground as soil moisture.

 
 

 Components
 Important information
 
 

 Lithosphere
 
 
It is the outer part of the Earth and other celestial bodies. It covers the rocky part of the body. On Earth, it is considered as the crust and the rigid upper mantle part.

 
 
 

 Hydrosphere
 It is the component of the Earth which covers about 70% of the surface. It includes the oceans, seas, lakes, ponds, rivers, and streams. 
 
 

 Biosphere
 It is the ecosystem that contains all the living beings and their relationship with nature. The term "Biosphere" was coined by geologist Eduard Suess in 1875. 
 
 

 Atmosphere
 It is kind of a blanket that contains gases and surrounds the Earth from outside. Where we live, we breathe, we act and we do daily activities are all part of the atmosphere.
